book.name: Matiu
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Matiu Le Rorori

content: Jisas orumburumbuye
Iyake Jisas Krais orumburumbuye utuutuninji. Jisas Krais iye Deivid rumbuye, Deivid iye Eibraham rumbuye.
Eibraham nariya Aisake, Aisake nariya Jeikob, Jeikob le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Juda na oghaghae,
Juda le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Peres na Seal, tɨnanjiya Tama, Peres nariya Hesɨron, Hesɨron nariya Ram,
Ram nariya Aminadab, Aminadab nariya Nason, Nason nariya Salmon,
Salmon nariya Bowasa, tɨnaya Reihab, Bowasa nariya Obedi, tɨnaya Rut, Obedi nariya Jese,
Jese nariya Kiŋ Deivid. Deivid nariya Solomon, tɨnae iye Uraiya va i vaŋgukai,
Solomon nariya Rehobowam, Rehobowam nariya Abaija, Abaija nariya Asa,
Asa nariya Jehosapat, Jehosapat nariya Joram, Joram nariya Usaiya,
Usaiya nariya Jotam, Jotam nariya Eihas, Eihas nariya Hejekaiya,
Hejekaiya nariya Manase, Manase nariya Emon, Emon nariya Josaiya,
Josaiya le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Jekonaiya na oghaghae, mbaŋaniye Babilon va thɨ mena thɨ kivwalaŋgiya Isirel na thɨ vaŋguŋgi vethiya yaku Babilon.
Va thɨ vaŋguŋgiya Isirel na vethɨ vaŋguraweŋgi Babilon na e ghereiye: Jekonaiya nariya Seyatiyel, Seyatiyel nariya Serubabol,
Serubabol nariya Abiyuda, Abiyuda nariya Ilaiyakim, Ilaiyakim nariya Eiso,
Eiso nariya Sedok, Sedok nariya Akim, Akim nariya Eliudɨ,
Eliudɨ nariya Eliyesa, Eliyesa nariya Meitan, Meitan nariya Jeikob,
na Jeikob nariya Josep Meri le ghɨmoru, iyava i ghamba Jisas, iya raŋake Mesaiya.

I mena weya Eibraham ghaghad Deivid tha theyaworo na theghevarɨ, Deivid na ghaghad va thɨ vaŋguŋgiya Isirel na thɨ raka Babilon, tha theyaworo na theghevarɨ na va e mbaŋako iyako na gheghad Mesaiya i virɨ tha theyaworo na theghevarɨ.
Jisas le virɨ utuutuniye
Jisas Krais le virɨ va ŋgora iyake. Tɨnae Meri ghaghaivaun weiye Josep, ko ma vamba thɨ ghe kaero i marabo Nyao Boboma le vurɨgheghe kaiwae.
Kaiwae Josep, Meri ghaghaivaun, iye ghathanavu va i thovuye, mava nuwaiya i vakatha na i monjina. Josep le renuwaŋa thuwele nuwaiya thɨ yawo weiye.

Ko le renuwaŋa thuweleko iyako e ghereiye Giya Loi le nyao thovuye i njawe ghenelolo e tɨne na i dagewe iŋa, “Josep, Deivid rumbuye, tha u mararu na u vaŋgwa Meri na len wevo, maraboke iyake i mena weya Nyao Boboma.
Ne i ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru na ne u uno idae Jisas, kaiwae ne i vamoruŋgiya le gharɨgharɨ lenji tharɨ e tɨne.”
Thiyake thɨ yomara na thɨ vaemunjoruŋa ŋgoroŋga Giya Loi va i utugiya weya ghalɨŋae gharautu,
“Thɨnabwethubwethuru nevole i marabo na i ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru na nevole thɨ rena idae Imanuwel.” Imanuwel gharumwaru “Loi iye weinda”.
Mbaŋa Josep i thuweiru, i vakatha ŋgoreiya Giya Loi le nyao thovuye me dagemawe i vaŋgwa Meri na levo.
Ko ma vamba i ndeloŋga mun weiye Meri gheghada i ghamba ŋgamako na Josep i rena idae Jisas.
